  cd /
  mkdir -p /root/work /tmp/work
  : > /tmp/daimon-handoff-left-out.txt
  members() { find . root mnt/session/outputs tmp/work -mindepth 1 \( -path './*' ! -type f -o -path './.*' -o -type f -size +20M \

    -o -path 'mnt/session/uploads' -o -path 'mnt/memory' -o -path 'mnt/skills' \

    \) -prune -o "$@"; }
  pack() { members -printf '%p\0' | tar czf /tmp/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz --no-recursion --anchored --no-wildcards --exclude-from=/tmp/daimon-handoff-left-out.txt --null -T -; }

    members ! -type d -printf '%D:%i %s %p\0' > /tmp/daimon-handoff-sizes
    unset w n k; declare -A w n k; total=0; while IFS= read -r -d '' e; do i=${e%% *}; e=${e#* }; p=${e#* }; w[$i]=$((${w[$i]-${e%% *}} + 1024)); n[$i]+=$p$'\n'
      [[ $p == *$'\n'* || $p == *[[:space:]] ]] && k[$i]=1; done < /tmp/daimon-handoff-sizes
    for i in "${!w[@]}"; do total=$((total + ${w[$i]})); echo "${w[$i]} $i"; done > /tmp/daimon-handoff-sizes
    while [ "$total" -gt 19922944 ] && read -r z i; do [ -n "${k[$i]-}" ] || { total=$((total - z)); printf %s "${n[$i]}"; }
    done < <(sort -rn /tmp/daimon-handoff-sizes) > /tmp/daimon-handoff-left-out.txt
    sed 's|^\./||; s|^|HANDOFF_LEFT_OUT /|; 50q' /tmp/daimon-handoff-left-out.txt
    c=$(wc -l < /tmp/daimon-handoff-left-out.txt); if [ "$c" -gt 50 ]; then echo "HANDOFF_LEFT_OUT_MORE $((c - 50))"; fi
    pack; size=$(stat -c %s /tmp/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz)
  fi
  if [ "$size" -gt 20971520 ]; then echo "HANDOFF_TOO_LARGE $size"; else cp /tmp/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz /mnt/session/outputs/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz && ls -l /mnt/session/outputs/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz || rm -f /mnt/session/outputs/daimon-handoff-0f9d1c4e-7c2b-4f5a-9d3e-1b2c3d4e5f60.tar.gz; fi
  rm -f /tmp/daimon-handoff-*
